label: School

example.title: East Side School (elementary and middle school), historic photograph

brief: Two-storey Romanesque Revival school in dark red brick on a tall rock-faced limestone basement: a broad hipped roof with a small ventilator cupola, and two square towers of unequal height flanking the front, each with an arcaded belfry stage of round-arched openings and a steep flared pyramidal roof with a spike finial. A deep round-arched main entrance in the lower tower, a balcony over a secondary entry, and long rows of tall one-over-one classroom windows with stone sill bands.
